system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson, two dark figures on a dark road, Holmes in ulster leading","action":"Holmes strides forward with a sharp turn toward the distant window, Watson following close, after a brief exchange with the landlord at the door","setting":"Night road outside a country inn near Stoke Moran, Surrey, wind blowing toward them, the path ahead dark","secondaryElements":"Single small yellow light glowing far off through the trees at the manor's middle upper window, the only light in view; dark tree silhouettes and a low park wall","mood":"Tense, sombre, restrained, gothic anticipation","timeOfDay":"Late night, around eleven, moonless and dark","composition":"Wide shot from behind the two men, small figures in the lower foreground, the distant lone light centred in the dark background as a guiding point"}
